comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Sur The Star (Handgun) (Wind)" / Star Pistol (R5)
"Victor Favor (Sword) (Wind)" / Guardian's Sword (R5)

Looks like the Winter Staff/Blume Staff error is fixed. As to those weapons above, they were part of a crossover event with another game, so it's highly doubtful we'll see them on Maris. Hope I'm wrong. Cheers.
